user.title: INFINITIX Smart Home
user.description:
This adds the INFINITIX dashboard to Home Assistant.

After you finish, open **INFINITIX** in the sidebar. The setup wizard starts automatically and builds the dashboard from your areas and entities. No YAML needed.

abort.single_instance_allowed: INFINITIX Smart Home is already set up.

init.title: INFINITIX options
init.description: Dashboard layout, theme and rooms are configured inside INFINITIX (admin only → Settings).
